cases.prompt: Score a canonical PDB on CPU using four threads. Report the weighted total, all unweighted score-term lanes, and the Cartesian gradient norm without changing the pose topology.
expected_behavior: Calls torch.set_num_threads(4) before rendering the scorer
Builds the pose and beta2016 score function on CPU
Uses sum_terms=False and apply_weights=False for canonical unweighted lanes
Computes a coordinate gradient through the rendered scorer
Labels scores as TMol score units rather than kcal/mol
